504    /**
505     * Generates random license plate.
506     *
507     * @param bool       $special      whether special license plates should be included
508     * @param array|null $voivodeships list of voivodeships license plate should be generated from
509     * @param array|null $counties     list of counties license plate should be generated from
510     */
511    public static function licensePlate(
512        bool $special = false,
513        ?array $voivodeships = null,
514        ?array $counties = null
515    ): string {
516        $voivodeshipsAvailable = static::$voivodeships + ($special ? static::$specials : []);
517        $voivodeshipSelected = static::selectRandomArea($voivodeshipsAvailable, $voivodeships);
518        $voivodeshipCode = static::randomElement($voivodeshipsAvailable[$voivodeshipSelected]);
519
520        $countiesAvailable = static::$counties[$voivodeshipSelected];
521        $countySelected = self::selectRandomArea($countiesAvailable, $counties);
522
523        $countyCode = static::randomElement(static::$counties[$voivodeshipSelected][$countySelected]);
524
525        $suffix = static::regexify(static::randomElement(strlen($countyCode) === 1 ? static::$plateSuffixesGroup1 : static::$plateSuffixesGroup2));
526
527        return "{$voivodeshipCode}{$countyCode} {$suffix}";
528    }
529
530    /**
531     * Selects random area from the list of available and requested.
532     *
533     * @return string
534     */
535    protected static function selectRandomArea(array $available, ?array $requested)
536    {
537        $requested = array_intersect(array_keys($available), $requested ?? []);
538
539        if (empty($requested)) {
540            $requested = array_keys($available);
541        }
542
543        return static::randomElement($requested);
544    }
545}
